functions.name: update-blueprint
functions.description: Partially update a Blueprint's descriptive fields or replace selected resource associations. Omitted fields retain their values; invalid association IDs may be dropped.

name.description: Replacement name; omission leaves it unchanged.

appIds.description: Replacement app membership; omit to preserve, [] to clear. Invalid IDs can be dropped.

items.description: Opaque app ID.

userIds.description: Replacement user membership; omit to preserve, [] to clear.

items.description: Opaque user ID.

deviceIds.description: Replacement organization device membership; omit to preserve, [] to clear.

items.description: Opaque organization device ID.

packageIds.description: Replacement package membership; omit to preserve, [] to clear.

items.description: Opaque package ID.

blueprintId.description: Opaque Blueprint ID in the connected organization.

description.description: Replacement description; empty string clears the text; omission leaves it unchanged. Null is not accepted.

userGroupIds.description: Replacement user group membership; omit to preserve, [] to clear.

items.description: Opaque user group ID.

configurationIds.description: Replacement configuration membership; omit to preserve, [] to clear.

items.description: Opaque configuration ID.

FunctionInput_apple_business_manager_upd.description: Blueprint identity and the descriptive fields or resource memberships to replace.

name.description: Returned name; omitted if absent.

status.description: Returned provider status without a closed enum; omitted if absent.

createdAt.description: Creation instant normalized to UTC Z without loss of precision; omitted if absent.

updatedAt.description: Last update instant normalized to UTC Z without loss of precision; omitted if absent.

description.description: Returned description, retaining null and empty text; omitted if absent.

appLicenseDeficient.description: Returned license deficiency indicator; omitted if absent.

FunctionOutput_apple_business_manager_up.description: Blueprint returned by the update API, without asserting membership or deployment completion.

tags.instructions: Get the ID from `list-blueprints`; inspect current attributes with `get-blueprint`. Omitted fields are unchanged. Association arrays replace the selected membership, so use the Add/Remove Blueprint association tools for incremental changes instead. An empty array clears that relationship. Invalid IDs may be dropped; inspect the corresponding List Blueprint IDs tool afterward. This is not a deployment-completion check.

functions.name: update-configuration
functions.description: Partially update a custom configuration's name, profile, filename, or target platforms.

name.description: Replacement display name; omitted means unchanged.

filename.description: Replacement filename ending in .mobileconfig; omitted means unchanged.

platforms.description: Replacement target-platform set; omitted retains the existing platforms.

items.description: Apple platform targeted by the configuration.

profileXml.description: Replacement Apple plist XML profile text; omitted means unchanged.

configurationId.description: Opaque ID of the custom configuration to modify.

FunctionInput_apple_business_manager_upd.description: A custom configuration ID and at least one replacement field; omitted fields remain unchanged.

id.description: Opaque ID of the updated configuration.

functions.name: update-device-management-service
functions.description: Partially update a service's name, certificate, release authority, or default product-family assignments.

name.description: Replacement service display name; omitted means unchanged.

certificatePem.description: Replacement public X.509 PEM certificate; omitted retains the current certificate.

allowDeviceRelease.description: Replacement release-authority setting; false revokes it, omission leaves it unchanged.

defaultProductFamilies.description: Replacement set of Apple product-family codes, such as IPAD or IPHONE; empty clears defaults, provisionally.

functions.name: update-device-migration-deadline
